name: otonari
description: Borrow from next door, in your own language. A PWA for neighbors in Japan.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.db: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
